svg.title: Line graph of activity (crossovers) against time over 120 minutes: after saline is injected into the nucleus accumbens at the start, activity in both groups falls to near zero; after amphetamine is injected into the nucleus accumbens at 60 minutes, rats with prior exposure to amphetamine (black circles) peak at about 43 crossovers at 80 minutes, against about 31 for rats getting amphetamine for the first time (white circles), and stay more active to the end (F = 5.79, p < 0.02).
